description: The body of an OpenSearch _search request, narrowed to the top-level keys Synapse accepts. Each slot's contents are pass-through OpenSearch query DSL; see the search REST endpoint for the inner-clause allowlist, field-reference rules, pagination semantics, and per-request limits.

query.description:
Required. The OpenSearch query DSL clause (the contents of the query key). Use {"match_all":{}} to match all documents. See query vs. filter context and term-level vs. full-text queries.

Supported full-text clauses: match, multi_match, match_phrase, match_phrase_prefix, match_bool_prefix, simple_query_string.

Supported term-level clauses: term, terms, range, exists, prefix, wildcard, fuzzy, ids.

Supported compound clauses: bool, dis_max, constant_score, boosting. The minimum_should_match and rewrite parameters are supported where OpenSearch accepts them.

post_filter.description: Optional. Same DSL shape as query (see the supported clause list there), applied after aggregations are computed. For the distinction between filtering hits and filtering aggregations, see query vs. filter context.

aggregations.description:
Optional (alias aggs). Map of caller-chosen name to aggregation definition. Supplying both aggregations and aggs simultaneously is rejected with HTTP 400. The raw aggregation result comes back on SearchQueryResults.aggregationResults.

Supported bucket aggregations: terms, histogram, date_histogram, range, date_range, missing.

Supported metric aggregations: min, max, avg, sum, stats, extended_stats, value_count, cardinality. For the facet-counting pattern (a terms aggregation alongside post_filter), see the faceted search tutorial.

suggest.description: Optional. A map of suggestion name to suggester definition (optionally alongside a top-level text). Allowlisted suggester types: term and phrase ("did you mean"), and completion. Returns query-assistance suggestions on SearchQueryResults.suggestResults.

highlight.description: Optional. Adds per-field snippet fragments (matched terms wrapped in <em> / </em> tags by default) to each SearchQueryResults.hits[*].highlights entry.

collapse.description: Optional. Groups the result list so only one hit is returned per distinct value of field.

rescore.description: Optional. Re-ranks the top window_size hits returned by query using a secondary scoring query.

sort.description: Optional. Result ordering. OpenSearch sort shape (string column name, {column: "asc|desc"}, or {column: {order: ...}}). The pseudo-column _score sorts by relevance. When omitted, results are sorted by relevance descending.

_source.description: Optional. Source filter. Accepts the full OpenSearch SourceConfig shape: a boolean, an array of column-name patterns (shorthand for {includes: [...]}), or {includes: [...], excludes: [...]}.

from.description: Optional. Zero-based pagination offset; default 0. Mutually exclusive with search_after > 0.

size.description: Optional. Maximum number of hits to return per page. Default: 25. Maximum: 100 (larger values are silently capped).

search_after.description: Optional. Opaque cursor emitted as nextSearchAfter on the previous response. Pass back unchanged. Mutually exclusive with from > 0.
